title: Rajasthan Treasures
shortDescription: If you are planning to visit the fascinating travel destinations of Rajasthan, our 6 Nights package will take you to the famous destinations in Rajasthan, from Jodhpur to Jaisalmer to Ranakpur and Udaipur.
description: If you are planning to visit the fascinating travel destinations of Rajasthan, our 6 Nights package will take you to the famous destinations in Rajasthan, from Jodhpur to Jaisalmer to Ranakpur and Udaipur. Our 7-day journey covers and showcases Rajasthan’s blend of rich culture, ancient history, desert landscapes, camel safaris, lakes, and natural beauty. Experience the heritage and rich culture of Rajasthan with DPauls tour packages, ranging from standard to luxury.

itinerary.title: Arrive Jodhpur and Drive to Jaisalmer City (280 Kms / 5 Hrs)
itinerary.description: On arrival at Jodhpur Airport, pick up and drive straight to Jaisalmer – the Golden City of Rajasthan. On arrival at Jaisalmer, check in at the hotel, and the rest of the day is at leisure to self-explore the city on your own.

itinerary.title: In Jaisalmer – Morning City Tour / Drive to Sam Sand Dunes
itinerary.description: Today, we explore Jaisalmer City – visit the Golden Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the very few living forts in the world, as nearly one-fourth of the city’s population still resides within the fort, followed by a visit to Jain Mandir – carved in yellow sandstone and dedicated to Jain hermits known as Tirthankars. Later, we visit Patwon Ki Haveli and Nathmalji Ki Haveli. Later, we proceed to the famous Sam Sand Dunes. Upon arrival, we experience thrilling dune bashing over the golden sands of Jaisalmer. In the evening, we get an opportunity to witness the spectacular beauty of the sandy terrain by taking a joyful camel ride and viewing the red-orange color splash of sunset on the desert horizon. Overnight stay in tent at Sam Sand Dunes, Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Drive to Jodhpur (280 Kms / 5 Hrs)
itinerary.description: Enjoy a relaxed morning and relish your breakfast. Later, check out from the Jaisalmer camp and drive to the Blue City of Rajasthan – Jodhpur. The drive will take about 5–6 hours. On arrival at your hotel in Jodhpur, check in, and the rest of the day is for relaxation and self-exploration of the nearby market.

itinerary.title: Jodhpur City Tour / Drive to Ranakpur (160 Kms / 3 Hrs)
itinerary.description: Today morning, after breakfast, check out and proceed for a city tour of the Blue City. We visit Mehrangarh Fort, the most famous Jodhpur attraction. After visiting the fort, we will visit Jaswant Thada, a beautiful white marble memorial built by Sardar Singh in 1899 in memory of Maharaja Jaswant Singh II. Later, we will visit the Clock Tower. Afterward, you will drive to Ranakpur, which is famous for its Jain temples. It will take around 3 hours to reach Ranakpur.

itinerary.title: Drive to Udaipur (90 Kms / 2 Hrs Approx.)
itinerary.description: Today morning, after breakfast and check out, visit the Ranakpur Temples, which are famous for their marble Jain temple dedicated to Tirthankara Adinatha. The temple is rich with sculptural pieces, with carvings created with great skill and artistry. After worshipping Shri Adinatha, visit the Sun Temple built in the 13th century, which is managed by the Udaipur royal family trust. Later, we will continue our journey to Udaipur. The drive will take around 2 hours. Known as the “Venice of the East,” Udaipur is a must-visit destination in Rajasthan. On arrival in Udaipur, check in to the hotel. The evening is free at your leisure to relax and explore nearby on your own.

itinerary.title: In Udaipur – Full Day City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, we will proceed for the Udaipur city tour. Visit Fateh Sagar Lake, Saheliyon Ki Bari – the Queen’s resort for her friends, Sukhadia Circle (drive past), and Bhartiya Lok Kala Museum – a museum of folk art that displays a rich collection of folk dresses, ornaments, puppets, masks, dolls, etc. Next, visit the City Palace – the largest palace complex in Rajasthan, and Jagdish Temple – built by Maharana Jagat Singh and dedicated to Lord Vishnu. Visit Lake Pichola in the evening. If you wish to enjoy a boat ride on Lake Pichola, it is available on a direct payment basis.

itinerary.title: Departure Transfer / Flight to Delhi
itinerary.description: Today morning, after breakfast and completing the check-out formalities, our car will report to the hotel to provide your departure transfer to Udaipur Airport in time to board the flight to your hometown or next destination. Our tour ends at Udaipur Airport. Tentative Itinerary. Note: Above Itinerary is just indicative. Do not consider it as a Final Schedule. Date & Time of Tours can be changed by Local Agent / Tour Operator.
